subject: Free website review for clinics with outdated sites
preheader: See three practical fixes for your clinic site, including booking and contact page improvements.
heading: A free review of your clinic website
intro:
Nour Studio offers a free one-page website review for clinic owners.

You will get three practical fixes you can make this week, focused on clarity, trust, and easier patient contact.

sections.heading: What the review covers
sections.body: We look at the main page people use to decide whether to contact you, book, or call. The review is short and specific, so you can see what matters most first.

sections.heading: A useful example for clinics
sections.body: For Dar Al Shifa Clinic, the booking page appears to have no Arabic version and lists only a landline number. Those are the kinds of issues that can make a site harder to use for patients.

sections.heading: What you receive
sections.body: You will get a simple note with three fixes you can apply this week. The goal is to make your site easier to understand and easier to act on.
